Application lifecycle

Platform-neutral lifecycle: create or import the application and dependencies; configure and validate it in DEV; promote a versioned release to QA for testing and approval; promote the approved release to PRD; monitor, support, secure, and recover it in operation; then prioritize enhancements and repeat the cycle. The platform name and workspace inventory are missing, so none of these capabilities can be confirmed as available today.
limitations: No verified inventory of migration, environment, release, approval, monitoring, rollback, or enhancement capabilities was supplied.
